description: This is the main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe mobile game. It includes the app setup, theming, game logic, and UI implementation for the game screen, including state management, AI move calculation, and interactive components.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Main application widget applying themes and routing to the game screen.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Encapsulates the game state, including the board, current player, scores, and game logic such as winner evaluation and move application.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the game interface, managing user interactions, game flow, animations, and UI components such as the board, header, footer, and controls.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: Stateless widget representing individual tiles on the game board with tap detection and visual styling.

classes.name: _PlayerChip
classes.description: Displays player labels and indicates active status with animations.

classes.name: _ModeToggle
classes.description: Widget to switch between two-player and versus computer modes.

classes.name: _ModeButton
classes.description: Button used within the mode toggle to select specific game modes.

classes.name: _ScoreCard
classes.description: Displays current game scores for X, O, and draws.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the Flutter app, initializes and runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: TicTacToeApp._colorScheme
methods.description: Defines the color scheme based on brightness mode.

methods.name: TicTacToeApp._theme
methods.description: Generates ThemeData using the color scheme, configuring visual styles.

methods.name: GameState.evaluateWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning combinations to determine if there's a winner or a draw.

methods.name: GameState.play
methods.description: Applies a move at the specified index if valid, updates game state and scores.

methods.name: GameState.resetRound
methods.description: Resets the board for a new round, optionally changing the starting player.

methods.name: GameState.resetAll
methods.description: Resets the entire game including scores.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on a board cell, applies move, and triggers the AI move if in vsComputer mode.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._bestMove
methods.description: Heuristic AI to select the optimal move, prioritizing winning, blocking, center, corners, or random move.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._changeMode
methods.description: Switches game mode between two-player and vsComputer.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._restartRound
methods.description: Restarts the current round, alternating which player starts.

methods.name: _GameScreenState._resetAll
methods.description: Resets the entire game state and scores.
